verdict.rationale: DeepInfra explicitly states a zero retention policy where inputs, outputs, and user data stay private, backed by SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification, directly addressing the no-training-on-data concern. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that data is never used to train models specifically, no independent audit/third-party confirmation, and no detail on opt-in/opt-out controls or enterprise-only vs default scope.
